title: Framework registry
description: The single source of truth for every evaluated thinking method (shipped or not). The catalog (docs/internal/research/framework-catalog.md), the advisor's recommendable set, and the public Framework Library are generated and drift-checked from this registry. Authored as frameworks/registry.mjs (a zero-dependency ES data module); this JSON Schema is the contract that scripts/check-registry.mjs enforces.

version.description: Registry schema version. Bump on a breaking shape change.

seededDate.description: ISO date the registry was seeded from the truthed-up catalog. The default evalDate for any entry that does not carry an explicit one.

families.description: The ordered catalog families (the 11-family universe taxonomy). Note: this is the catalog taxonomy, which differs by design from the live skill metadata.family slugs (those are a separate, coarser grouping the shipped skills + Astro site use).

name.description: Display (prose) family name used in the generated catalog headers.

slug.description: Kebab method name, no think- prefix. Unique. For status: shipped, skills/think-<slug>/ must exist; for status: recipe, _workflows/think-<slug>.md must exist.

family.description: One of the 11 catalog family slugs; must also appear in the top-level families list (referential).

tier.description: Honest evidence grade (governing grade, single value): S strong / M moderate / P practitioner / V vendor / A anecdotal / C conceptually-plausible-under-tested / X poor-or-contradictory (never ships).

status.description: shipped (a built skill) / next (strongest unbuilt) / recipe (ships as a _workflows chain, not a standalone skill) / cand (clears the bar, lower priority) / fold (subsumed by a shipped skill) / flag (include only with caveats) / pm (defer to pm-skills) / excl (excluded on the merits).

evalDate.description: ISO date the verdict was set or last confirmed. Optional: defaults to the registry's seededDate. Set explicitly only when an entry is re-vetted on a different date.

foldInto.description: Required when status or verdict is fold. A slug that must resolve to a status: shipped entry.

evalCases.description: skills/think-<slug>/eval/cases.md. Required when status: shipped (couples to the SP1 eval-case validator).

dossierPath.description: frameworks/<slug>/dossier.md, or the literal 'pending'. Optional until SP4 (the Framework Library) lands. Any non-pending value must resolve to a real file.

attribution.description: Author/origin (e.g. 'Edward de Bono, 1985'). Required when branded is true.

trademark.description: Trademark / owner / license string. Required when branded is true (the SP9 IP lint).

branded.description: True for IP / trademarked / proprietary frameworks. Opening the IP gate (SP9) does not lower the evidence gate.

aliases.description: Other names so search and dedupe catch synonyms.
